status: research hypothesis, not a specification or demonstrated generalization
kernel_observation: state::fold is a projection over accepted acts; replacement identities, admission evidence and equivocation accountability are separate semantic obligations.
generalization: Authenticated reconstruction of signed member views plus verified continuation, with rule-specific summaries and compaction laws.
candidate_contracts: render(advance(summary(H), D)) = fold(H union D) for admissible uncovered D, including duplicates and concurrent branches
Authenticated reconstruction of each required member view from snapshot evidence
Compaction preserves continuation, causal admission and accountable evidence; only historical views covered by the reconstruction contract may be forgotten
semantic_mismatches: Acumen uses per-user causal chains and rejects conflicting forks; CBCL equivocation detection is verdict-neutral and does not exclude both valid members.
CBCL causal admission is independently checked and can require predecessor closure; an authenticated fold does not replace it.
Acumen structural reconstruction and tombstone garbage collection are Treedoc-specific.
Current visible state alone may not reconstruct a lagging member state or aggregate.

rule_profiles.candidate_first: ValuesPerKey, RegisterPerKey, ObservedSet and LatestPerSigner with live operation IDs, replacement evidence, scope and causal coverage
rule_profiles.aggregates: Count and Counter require authenticated contributions or member/cut baselines; scalar totals do not establish completeness or historical reconstruction
rule_profiles.derived: Histogram and Sum can be recomputed from authenticated complete source maps when these maps are available
rule_profiles.special: Progress requires causal position evidence; BoundedCounter requires resource certificates and permanent local obligations
rule_profiles.output_sensitive: Events and grow-only sets may inherently be history-sized

prototype: Fixed-member drawing dialect; independent baseline replay; verify old/concurrent edits, snapshots based on snapshots, unequal GC horizons and equivocation; measure cold-open bytes, metadata size and member-lag dependence.
scaling_caveat: Do not claim history-independent space with arbitrarily stale member descriptors, unlimited member growth, growing live output or uncontrolled concurrency.
